title: Margin % and % of Total show a dash when Parts Invoiced is zero or less
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, left on Default for work orders and Part Sales.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer D, with a found part with no cost and a typed price of −$5.00, and line 1 labor of $100.00 so the invoice total is positive, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  2. Pick customers A and D in the Customer filter.
  3. Pick only customer D in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 2:

  • The Manual row reads Parts Invoiced −$5.00 and Parts Margin % "—".
  • The Manual row's % of Total reads −4.29% (−$5.00 ÷ $116.50); tier A's reads 104.29% ($121.50 ÷ $116.50).
  • Totals read Parts Invoiced $116.50 ($121.50 − $5.00).

Step 3:

  • The Manual row and the Totals read "—" for % of Total (Totals' Parts Invoiced is −$5.00).
  • Parts Margin % reads "—" too.
